title: French Ankle Ligament Surgery Cohort Study
official: Prospective Follow-up Study of Patients Undergoing Ankle Ligament Surgery
summary: This 20-year cohort study foolows patients after ankle ligament reconstruction surgery to evaluate re-rupture rates, long term functional outcomes, return to sport rates ans complications?
